items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I never knew his last name. Yeah, a few people talked about him.

ctx.x: You know, just take your stick out there. That's right. You know, just take your stick out there. That's right. You know, I didn't know it.

I didn't know it. I didn't know it. I have a Bolton. I know his name was Bolton Bure or whatever you want. He was a tough boy, man. He kept getting a belly. Yeah, he was a tough boy, man. He kept getting a belly. Yeah. He was a professional drummer. He was a professional drummer. He was uncool though. He was uncool though. He'd come and pick up your stick. Give me a stick. You didn't know what you were doing. You might play something. Just like that. You know, just take your stick out there. That's a bully. You…
it. Get out of the way. He didn't hear. I guess that stopped the parade, wouldn't it? Yeah.
